_readme: Golden canonical signing payloads for COMPOSITION certification records (CompositionCertificationRecordSigner). These bytes are the message every composition admission signature is computed over, so they are pinned here and read by the in-repo golden test. To regenerate a case deliberately, copy the actual payload the failing test prints into this file. Regenerate ONLY when the canonical form is deliberately changed, and understand that changing it invalidates every composition signature already written. Doubles are deliberately restricted to exactly representable values: decimal formatting of arbitrary doubles is not identical across every target this tree builds for.

cases.name: composition-populated
cases.why: Every field carrying a non-default value, plus the two the composition payload must structurally exclude (signature, gate). Structural mutant id lists are supplied out of order to pin the ordinal sort, and the reason string pins the escaping of quote, angle brackets, ampersand, apostrophe, plus and non-ASCII.

record.reason: golden fixture — quote " angle < & > apostrophe ' plus + café

cases.name: composition-minimal
cases.why: Only the required members. Pins that the payload still carries all 12 names with null values and empty arrays - a small payload is legitimate, an empty one is not.

cases.name: composition-escaping
cases.why: Non-ASCII, a control character, a surrogate pair, a tab, and every character the default JavaScript encoder escapes - in compositionId and reason. Pins the encoder and its uppercase hex.
